SELECT 1 FROM sportovci s WHERE s.id=? AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM coach_scope_grants g JOIN treneri cg_t ON cg_t.id=g.trainer_id AND cg_t.aktivni=1 JOIN staff_user_positions cg_p ON cg_p.trainer_id=g.trainer_id AND cg_p.position_code='coach' WHERE g.trainer_id=7 AND g.revoked_at IS NULL AND g.valid_from<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND (g.valid_to IS NULL OR g.valid_to>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND ((g.scope_kind='team' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM club_roster_members cm JOIN club_teams ct ON ct.id=cm.team_id WHERE cm.sportovec_id=s.id AND cm.team_id=g.scope_id AND cm.status='active' AND ct.status='active' AND cm.valid_from<=CURRENT_DATE AND (cm.valid_to IS NULL OR cm.valid_to>=CURRENT_DATE)))))
SELECT id FROM sportovci WHERE id = ?

SELECT 1 FROM account_person_roles r JOIN verejni_uzivatele a ON a.id=r.account_id WHERE r.account_id=? AND r.sportovec_id=? AND r.relation_role IN ('self','guardian') AND r.status='approved' AND r.valid_from<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND (r.valid_to IS NULL OR r.valid_to>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND a.aktivni=1 AND a.email_overeno=1 LIMIT 1

SELECT t.id,t.delka FROM treninky t JOIN ( SELECT trenink_id FROM trenink_sportovec WHERE sportovec_id=:attendance_sid UNION SELECT tm.trenink_id FROM trenink_mereni tm JOIN mereni_zaznamy mz ON mz.id=tm.mereni_id WHERE mz.sportovec_id=:measurement_sid ) owned ON owned.trenink_id=t.id ORDER BY t.datum DESC,t.id DESC

SELECT t.id,t.datum,t.delka,t.napln,t.obrazky FROM treninky t JOIN ( SELECT trenink_id FROM trenink_sportovec WHERE sportovec_id=:attendance_sid UNION SELECT tm.trenink_id FROM trenink_mereni tm JOIN mereni_zaznamy mz ON mz.id=tm.mereni_id WHERE mz.sportovec_id=:measurement_sid ) owned ON owned.trenink_id=t.id WHERE t.id IN (:id0,:id1,:id2,:id3,:id4,:id5,:id6,:id7,:id8,:id9,:id10,:id11,:id12,:id13,:id14,:id15,:id16,:id17,:id18,:id19,:id20,:id21,:id22,:id23,:id24) ORDER BY t.datum DESC,t.id DESC
SELECT trenink_id,poznamka FROM sportovec_poznamka WHERE sportovec_id=? AND trenink_id IN (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)

SELECT tm.trenink_id,tm.poradi,mz.id AS mereni_id,mz.typ, mz.vzdalenost,mz.distance_unit,mz.cas,mz.prevod,mz.cvik_id,mz.segment_id, mz.vaha,mz.opakovani,mz.rpe,mz.poznamka AS mereni_poznamka, c.nazev AS cvik_nazev,seg.nazev AS segment_nazev FROM trenink_mereni tm JOIN mereni_zaznamy mz ON mz.id=tm.mereni_id LEFT JOIN cviky c ON c.id=mz.cvik_id LEFT JOIN segmenty seg ON seg.id=mz.segment_id WHERE tm.trenink_id IN (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?) AND mz.sportovec_id=? ORDER BY tm.trenink_id ASC,tm.poradi ASC,mz.id ASC
